panels.description: Top 10 highest-traffic request URIs over time.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (uri) (count_over_time({job="photos-backend", target="tower_http::trace::on_response"} | json uri="span.uri" | uri != "" [$__interval])))

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({job="photos-backend", target="tower_http::trace::on_response"} | json | status >= 400 and status < 500 [$__interval]))

panels.title: Job queue depth
panels.description: Jobs in flight at each point in time, split into not-yet-started and started. Filterable by user.

panels.title: Jobs finished per interval by type
panels.description: Throughput of completed work, split by job type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at,$__interval), job_type, count(*) FROM jobs WHERE status='done' AND ($user::integer = -1 OR user_id = $user::integer) AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Average job duration by type
panels.description: Average execution time in seconds (finished_at - started_at) per completed job type.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, $__interval), job_type, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at))) AS avg_duration_sec FROM jobs WHERE status = 'done' AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) AND ($user::integer = -1 OR user_id = $user::integer) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most common failure reasons
panels.description: Grouped jobs.last_error: what actually broke, most frequent first.

targets.rawSql:
WITH failures AS (
  SELECT coalesce(last_error, 'Unknown error') AS last_error, count(*)::bigint AS occurrences, max(finished_at) AS last_seen
  FROM jobs
  WHERE status = 'failed' AND ($user::integer = -1 OR user_id = $user::integer) AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT last_error, occurrences, last_seen FROM failures
UNION ALL
SELECT 'None' AS last_error, 0::bigint AS occurrences, NULL::timestamptz AS last_seen
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM failures)
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Storage breakdown by MIME type / format
panels.description: Total library disk space grouped by media format.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT mf.mime_type AS format, SUM(mf.size_bytes)::bigint AS bytes
FROM media_features mf
JOIN media_item m ON m.id = mf.media_item_id
WHERE m.deleted = false AND ($user::integer = -1 OR m.user_id = $user::integer)
GROUP BY mf.mime_type
ORDER BY bytes DESC

panels.title: Library totals
panels.description: Total items, storage size, photos and videos for the selected user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  count(m.id)::bigint AS total_items,
  coalesce(sum(mf.size_bytes), 0)::bigint AS total_bytes,
  count(m.id) FILTER (WHERE m.is_video = false)::bigint AS photos,
  count(m.id) FILTER (WHERE m.is_video = true)::bigint AS videos
FROM media_item m
LEFT JOIN media_features mf ON mf.media_item_id = m.id
WHERE m.deleted = false AND ($user::integer = -1 OR m.user_id = $user::integer)
